We have many templates returned. Need a retrosynthesis route with 1 reaction (i.e., a single step) to produce target SMILES COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. The guidance mentions Diels-Alder reaction forward. So retrosynthesis: break the cyclohexene ring to diene + dienophile. The target appears to be a bicyclic lactone? Actually SMILES: COC(=O)C@12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O? Wait: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. That's a methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone? The Diels-Alder would give a cyclohexene fused to something.

We need to find a template that corresponds to a Diels-Alder retro step. Search for templates with bonds formed 6-6 and functional groups broken/formed maybe "C-C double bonds". The earlier search gave many templates but not necessarily Diels-Alder. Could search for "Diels-Alder" but not possible. Maybe use template ID from list that matches Diels-Alder. Look at reaction_id 149675 etc. Not sure.

We can try to apply a template to see if it matches target. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with candidate template IDs. Choose one from list, maybe 149675.
